entities.name: UniProt Q6YXR9
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Physcomitrium patens NAD(P)H-quinone oxidoreductase subunit 2, chloroplastic.
501 aa, 55.9 kDa calculated; predicted multi-pass thylakoid membrane subunit of chloroplast NDH.
Pfam Ndh2_N (PF19530.4) at residues 1–100 and Proton_antipo_M (PF00361.26) at residues 129–425.

Reference annotation: NDH transfers electrons from NAD(P)H toward quinones and couples electron transfer to proton translocation; plastoquinone is believed to be the immediate acceptor in this species.
